preconditions.description: The number of nodes N must be between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= U <= N and 1 <= V <= N for U, V in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (U, V) must have endpoints U and V within the valid node range [1, N].
The input must contain exactly N-1 edges, forming a tree.
The edges must form a valid tree (connected and acyclic) with N nodes.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string representing the maximum number of connected components achievable by performing the described operation any number of times.

postconditions.expression: max_components == len(components) if components := compute_components(edges, N) else 0
postconditions.description: The maximum number of connected components is equal to the number of connected components in the forest obtained by optimally performing the operation.
